profile.name: Vansh Bhati
profile.tagline: I turn data and business problems into practical solutions.
profile.intro: I work with startups across data analysis, business analysis, and workflow automation—helping teams make better decisions and get things done.
profile.about: I’m Vansh Bhati, a Computer Science engineer based in Indore. My work spans data analysis, business analysis, internal systems and startup operations. I investigate the problem, structure the information and build practical ways forward.
profile.story: Alongside my technical and operational work, I am a published fiction author and create content as @whenvanshwrites. Writing strengthens the same skills I bring to products: observation, structure and clear communication.
profile.approach: Start with the business question. Understand the data and workflow, evaluate the options, and turn the findings into a useful recommendation or working system. I’m building toward Product Management through hands-on analysis and implementation.

resume.summary: Data Analyst · Business Analyst · Startup Problem Solver. B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, working across analysis, workflow automation and software development. Founder’s Associate, independent builder and published fiction writer.
